patch_description: This redesign merges the pre- and post-entanglement RZ rotation phases into a single unified phase schedule using only two shared parameters (rz_phase_a and rz_phase_b). This reduces parameter count from 62 to 48 while maintaining expressivity through a cleaner architectural flow: initialization → phase prep → linear entanglement → unified reverse chain with single CRZ parameter → final measurement. The simplified structure reduces optimization landscape complexity, enabling faster convergence and better generalization. This builds on the successful 50-parameter design that achieved 0.91 score while removing unnecessary mid-circuit layers.
